newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: US says it now second-largest Swiss export market.
newsitem.headline: US says it now second-largest Swiss export market.

text.p: The United States has overtaken France as Switzerland's second-largest export market, according to a statement released by the U.S. information service here.

It said that according to data released by the Swiss customs authorities Thursday, in the first four months of 1997, Swiss exports to the U.S. rose by over 17 percent while exports to all other countries, including those in the European Union, increased by less than half that amount.

The information office said that the U.S. has become a growing importer of Swiss machinery, organic chemicals, clocks and watches, electrical equipment, optical and medical instruments and pharmaceuticals.
U.S. exports to Switzerland have also grown rapidly but the U.S. market share remained low, it said.

A spokesman for the Swiss customs authorities said that Germany led Swiss exports in the first four months, with a total value of 7.77 billion Swiss francs. Exports to the U.S. totaled 3.116 billion in the first four months, he said. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
